description: This file defines the 'ClaimRequest' entity class used in a Human Resource Management system, specifically representing a claim request for an employee. It includes properties such as employee details, creator, claim event, status, and timestamps, along with ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: ClaimRequest
classes.description: Entity class representing a claim request within the HRM system, with properties for employee, creator, claim event, currency, status, timestamps, and deletion flag, using Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the claim request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the claim request.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the employee associated with the claim request.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Assigns an employee to the claim request.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user who created the claim request.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user who created the claim request.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Gets the reference ID for the claim request.

methods.name: setReferenceId
methods.description: Sets the reference ID for the claim request.

methods.name: getClaimEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the associated claim event.

methods.name: setClaimEvent
methods.description: Assigns a claim event to the claim request.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Gets the optional description of the claim request.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the optional description of the claim request.

methods.name: getCurrencyType
methods.description: Retrieves the currency type associated with the claim.

methods.name: setCurrencyType
methods.description: Assigns a currency type to the claim.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the claim request is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the claim request as deleted or not.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the claim request.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of the claim request.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the claim request was created.

methods.name: setCreatedDate
methods.description: Sets the creation date of the claim request.

methods.name: getSubmittedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the claim was submitted, if any.

methods.name: setSubmittedDate
methods.description: Sets the submission date of the claim.
